news.titleEn: Fed's Waller says central bank may need to 'shock people' with half-point rate hike
news.conclusionEn: Fed Governor Christopher Waller said a half-point rate hike is probably necessary at the Dec. 8-9 meeting, as the October minutes showed almost all officials expect further increases.
news.conclusionZh: 美联储理事沃勒称12月可能需加息50个基点
news.whyEn: A faster tightening path pushes up borrowing costs worldwide, strengthens the dollar and weighs on stocks, gold and emerging-market currencies.
news.whyZh: 加息加快将推高全球融资成本、推升美元，压制股市、黄金和新兴市场货币
news.detailEn: Waller told CNBC that inflation is "headed in the wrong direction, and it's spreading out," and that the Fed should reverse its three 2025 rate cuts and possibly go further. Inflation reignited after the U.S. and Israeli strikes on Iran in February, and most readings have been above 3%. Futures now fully price a quarter-point hike in December plus another move in January. Other officials, including New York Fed President John Williams, favour a more gradual approach, so the size of the December move remains the key debate.
news.detailZh: 沃勒在接受CNBC采访时表示，通胀「方向不对且正在扩散」，美联储应收回2025年的三次降息，甚至可能需要更多。自2月美以对伊朗动武后通胀再起，多数数据都高于3%。期货市场已完全定价12月加息25个基点、1月再加息一次。纽约联储主席威廉姆斯等官员倾向更渐进的节奏，因此12月加息幅度成为最大看点。

news.titleEn: Anthropic IPO raises over $81 billion in largest offering on record, topping SpaceX
news.conclusionEn: Anthropic priced its IPO at $83 a share, above its $70-$78 range, raising about $81.3 billion and setting a new record for the largest IPO ever.
news.conclusionZh: Anthropic以每股83美元定价，募资813亿美元创纪录
news.whyEn: The deal is a major test of investor appetite for AI and could reshape index weightings and tech-sector valuations once it trades.
news.whyZh: 这是对AI投资热情的重大检验，上市后可能影响指数权重和科技股估值
news.detailEn: Anthropic upsized the offering to roughly 980 million shares from a planned 825 million, surpassing SpaceX's $75 billion IPO. At $83, its valuation exceeds the roughly $1.4 trillion it had previously targeted. The shares are expected to begin trading on the Nasdaq under the ticker "ANT" on Thursday, November 19. Nasdaq-100 futures rose ahead of the debut, and its first-day performance will be read as a signal for the broader AI trade.
news.detailZh: Anthropic将发行规模从计划的8.25亿股上调至约9.8亿股，超过SpaceX的750亿美元IPO。按83美元计算，估值高于此前约1.4万亿美元的目标。股票预计于11月19日周四在纳斯达克上市，代码「ANT」。上市前纳斯达克100期货走高，首日表现将被视为整个AI板块情绪的风向标。

news.titleEn: Nvidia sinks after earnings, dragging down neoclouds CoreWeave, Iren
news.conclusionEn: Nvidia shares fell 2.89% despite third-quarter revenue of $115.84 billion and a $130 billion fourth-quarter forecast that both beat estimates.
news.conclusionZh: 英伟达财报超预期，股价却下跌2.89%
news.whyEn: As the most heavily weighted stock in major indexes, Nvidia's reaction sets the tone for AI-related stocks and the wider market.
news.whyZh: 英伟达是主要指数权重最大的股票，其走势决定AI板块乃至大盘情绪
news.detailEn: Revenue topped the $109.10 billion consensus and guidance beat the $125.1 billion expected, yet the stock reversed early gains and is down more than 13% over the past week. The results came amid turmoil after former CEO Jensen Huang resigned last week, and the board chair said he would not return as CEO. A new Commerce Department rule restricts Chinese firms' remote access to compute in overseas data centers, and Nvidia's outlook assumes no data-center revenue from China. CoreWeave and Iren also fell.
news.detailZh: 营收高于1091亿美元的市场预期，指引也高于1251亿美元的预期，但股价冲高回落，过去一周累计下跌超过13%。财报发布正值前CEO黄仁勋上周辞职引发的动荡，董事会主席表示他不会回任CEO。美国商务部新规限制中国企业远程使用海外数据中心算力，英伟达的业绩指引已不计入任何中国数据中心收入。CoreWeave和Iren等「新云」股同步下跌。

news.titleEn: Iran widens Gulf attacks by targeting U.S. air base in Kuwait and sites in Bahrain
news.conclusionEn: Iran targeted the Ali Al Salem air base in Kuwait and launched several attacks on Bahrain, apparently retaliating for a U.S. strike on a missile site on Qeshm Island.
news.conclusionZh: 伊朗袭击科威特美军基地及巴林多处目标
news.whyEn: Escalation around the Strait of Hormuz threatens oil shipping and keeps energy prices and inflation risk elevated.
news.whyZh: 霍尔木兹海峡周边升级威胁石油运输，使能源价格和通胀风险居高不下
news.detailEn: It was Iran's first attack on Kuwait in about two months; Kuwait said its air defences intercepted the drones with no immediate damage reported. Bahrain, home to the U.S. Navy's 5th Fleet, also said it intercepted several Iranian attacks. The exchanges come amid a U.S. naval blockade of Iran and continued Iranian attacks on tankers in Hormuz. Analysts warn the accumulation of incidents raises the risk of miscalculation, and the U.S. has sent a third aircraft carrier to the region.
news.detailZh: 这是伊朗约两个月来首次袭击科威特，科威特称防空系统拦截了无人机，暂未报告损失。驻有美国海军第五舰队的巴林也称拦截了多次伊朗袭击。这些交火发生在美国对伊朗实施海上封锁、伊朗持续袭击霍尔木兹海峡油轮的背景下。分析人士警告，事件不断累积会提高误判风险，美国已向该地区派出第三艘航母。

news.titleEn: Dow drops more than 500 points; S&P 500 falls for fifth day as Nvidia sells off
news.conclusionEn: The Dow fell 561 points (1.11%) to 50,198 and the S&P 500 slipped 0.23% for a fifth straight loss, while the Nasdaq rose 0.42%.
news.conclusionZh: 道指跌561点，标普500连跌五日
news.whyEn: The S&P 500's longest losing streak since June shows investors growing cautious as rate-hike expectations rise.
news.whyZh: 标普500创6月以来最长连跌，反映加息预期升温下投资者转趋谨慎
news.detailEn: UnitedHealth fell 10%, Chevron dropped almost 4% and Caterpillar lost more than 2%, weighing on the Dow. Energy was the worst S&P 500 sector, down nearly 3%, as crude fell after a rise in U.S. inventories. Nvidia reversed early gains to close about 2.9% lower. Investors are now watching Anthropic's debut and the path of Fed policy for direction.
news.detailZh: 联合健康下跌10%、雪佛龙跌近4%、卡特彼勒跌逾2%，拖累道指。由于美国原油库存增加导致油价下跌，能源板块跌近3%，为标普500表现最差板块。英伟达冲高回落，收跌约2.9%。投资者接下来关注Anthropic上市首日表现和美联储政策走向。

news.titleEn: Stocks slip with eyes on Anthropic and Nvidia, oil prices slide
news.conclusionEn: Global stocks slipped and U.S. crude fell 3.3% to $83.17 a barrel on bigger-than-expected inventory builds, while the dollar index hit a 19-month high.
news.conclusionZh: 美油跌3.3%，美元指数创19个月新高
news.whyEn: Falling oil eases some inflation pressure, but a surging dollar tightens financial conditions for importers and emerging markets.
news.whyZh: 油价下跌缓解部分通胀压力，但美元走强收紧进口国和新兴市场的金融环境
news.detailEn: Brent fell 1.4% to $91.84 as U.S. crude and fuel inventories rose more than expected. MSCI's global stock gauge fell 0.45% and Europe's STOXX 600 dropped 1.03%. The dollar index rose to 103.79 after Waller's hawkish comments, and copper slid 4.54%. Oil remains elevated relative to pre-war levels because of the conflict in the Gulf.
news.detailZh: 由于美国原油和燃料库存增幅超预期，布伦特原油下跌1.4%至91.84美元。MSCI全球股指下跌0.45%，欧洲STOXX 600下跌1.03%。沃勒鹰派讲话后美元指数升至103.79，铜价下跌4.54%。受海湾冲突影响，油价仍明显高于战前水平。

news.titleEn: Gold drops to 14-month low as dollar, yields rise on hawkish Fed rhetoric
news.conclusionEn: Spot gold fell 2.9% to about $3,739 an ounce, its lowest since September 2025, and silver dropped 4.5%, as the dollar and yields rose.
news.conclusionZh: 金价跌至14个月低点，白银跌4.5%
news.whyEn: Higher rates raise the opportunity cost of holding non-yielding gold, hitting investors who used it as an inflation or war hedge.
news.whyZh: 利率上升提高持有无息黄金的机会成本，冲击将黄金当避险工具的投资者
news.detailEn: Gold touched $3,734.76, its lowest since September 26, 2025, while platinum fell 3.8% and is down 33% this year. The dollar reached a 19-month high on signals from Waller, Williams and Musalem that more hikes may be needed. Markets assign about a 92% chance of a quarter-point hike in December and 8% for a half-point move. Analysts say further hawkish signals could keep pressure on precious metals.
news.detailZh: 金价盘中触及3734.76美元，为2025年9月26日以来最低；铂金下跌3.8%，年内累计跌33%。沃勒、威廉姆斯和穆萨莱姆暗示可能需要更多加息，推动美元升至19个月高点。市场认为12月加息25个基点的概率约92%，加息50个基点的概率约8%。分析人士认为，若鹰派信号持续，贵金属仍将承压。

news.titleEn: Trump arrives in China for historic meeting with Xi, Putin
news.conclusionEn: Trump arrived in Shenzhen for the APEC summit, where Xi greeted him on the tarmac ahead of first-ever trilateral talks with Xi and Putin on Thursday.
news.conclusionZh: 特朗普抵达深圳，将与习近平、普京三方会谈
news.whyEn: Outcomes on trade, AI chips, Ukraine and Iran could move markets and reshape relations among the three biggest military powers.
news.whyZh: 贸易、AI芯片、乌克兰和伊朗议题的结果可能影响市场及三大国关系
news.detailEn: Trump's delegation includes Marco Rubio, Scott Bessent and Howard Lutnick. The agenda is expected to cover the Iran war, Russia's war in Ukraine, trade and AI, and the two sides may seek a trade truce extending beyond January 2027. U.S. efforts to curb AI chip exports to China are also a sensitive topic. Expectations for concrete outcomes from the trilateral meeting remain low.
news.detailZh: 特朗普的随行人员包括鲁比奥、贝森特和卢特尼克。议程预计涵盖伊朗战争、俄乌战争、贸易和人工智能，中美双方可能寻求将贸易休战延长至2027年1月之后。美国限制对华AI芯片出口也是敏感议题。外界对三方会谈取得具体成果的预期不高。

news.titleEn: UnitedHealth Sinks 12% on CMS Fraud Rule as Warren Says Giants "Take a Cut at Every Step"
news.conclusionEn: Health insurer stocks tumbled, with UnitedHealth and Humana down sharply, after CMS proposed a "CRUSH" rule to expand Medicare Advantage audits and claw back overpayments.
news.conclusionZh: 美国新医保审计规则草案重挫保险股
news.whyEn: The rule could cost Medicare Advantage insurers billions a year and hits a sector widely held by pension and index funds.
news.whyZh: 新规可能让医保优势计划保险商每年损失数十亿美元，冲击被广泛持有的板块
news.detailEn: The proposed rule would extrapolate audit findings from a sample of Medicare Advantage charts to entire contracts and claw back overpayments dating back to payment year 2018. Humana, the most exposed insurer, fell even more than UnitedHealth, while CVS dropped 5%. It is still a proposal, with public comments open until January 19, 2027. Oppenheimer expects legal challenges similar to those that sank a 2025 framework.
news.detailZh: 该规则草案将把医保优势计划抽样审计的结果推算到整个合同，并追回自2018支付年度以来的超额支付。敞口最大的Humana跌幅甚至超过联合健康，CVS下跌5%。该规则仍处于提案阶段，公众意见征集截至2027年1月19日。奥本海默预计它将面临类似2025年框架被推翻时的法律挑战。

news.titleEn: Palo Alto inks $4.5 billion deal for AI startup Applied Compute, shares pop 7% on earnings
news.conclusionEn: Palo Alto Networks beat estimates with 39% revenue growth and agreed to buy AI startup Applied Compute in a $4.5 billion all-stock deal.
news.conclusionZh: Palo Alto财报超预期，45亿美元收购AI初创公司
news.whyEn: It shows cybersecurity giants racing to secure enterprise AI models, a fast-growing spending area for corporations.
news.whyZh: 显示网络安全巨头正抢占企业AI模型安全这一快速增长的支出领域
news.detailEn: Fiscal first-quarter revenue reached $3.44 billion versus $3.31 billion expected, and next-generation security ARR grew 66% to $9.73 billion. The company raised its fiscal 2027 revenue guidance to $14.52-$14.57 billion. Applied Compute helps businesses run and customize their own AI models, and CEO Nikesh Arora said the deal "could be bigger than what we do." Shares rose more than 7% after hours and are up 85% this year.
news.detailZh: 第一财季营收34.4亿美元，高于33.1亿美元的预期；新一代安全业务年化经常性收入增长66%至97.3亿美元。公司将2027财年营收指引上调至145.2亿至145.7亿美元。Applied Compute帮助企业运行和定制自有AI模型，CEO阿罗拉称这笔交易「可能比我们现有业务还大」。股价盘后上涨超过7%，年内累计上涨85%。

businessTips.explanationEn: Regulatory risk is the chance that a change in laws, rules or how they are enforced damages a company's revenue, costs or business model. It is especially high for businesses that depend on government payments, licences or subsidies. Because regulators can move suddenly, smart managers track proposed rules early, model the worst case, and avoid building the whole business on one favourable policy.
businessTips.explanationZh: 监管风险是指法律、规则或执法方式的变化损害公司收入、成本或商业模式的可能性。依赖政府付款、牌照或补贴的企业风险尤其高。由于监管可能突然变化，聪明的管理者会提前跟踪规则草案、测算最坏情况，并避免把整个生意押在单一的有利政策上。
businessTips.exampleEn: U.S. health insurers fell sharply this week after Medicare proposed tougher audits, because much of their profit comes from government programmes. Cigna fell far less because it had already sold its Medicare Advantage business, showing how diversification reduces regulatory exposure.
businessTips.exampleZh: 本周美国医保提出更严格的审计规则后，健康保险股大跌，因为它们大量利润来自政府项目。信诺跌幅小得多，因为它早已出售医保优势业务，说明业务多元化能降低监管敞口。

businessTips.term: Strategic Exit (Selling to a Strategic Buyer)
businessTips.explanationEn: A strategic exit is when a founder sells the business to a company in the same or a related industry that values it for synergies, not just its profits. Strategic buyers often pay more than financial buyers because the acquired product, customers or team fits their existing business. Knowing who your likely strategic buyers are helps you decide what to build and which relationships to nurture early.
businessTips.explanationZh: 战略退出是指创始人把企业卖给同行或相关行业的公司，对方看重的是协同效应，而不只是利润。战略买家往往比财务买家出价更高，因为被收购的产品、客户或团队能与其现有业务契合。尽早弄清潜在战略买家是谁，有助于决定该做什么产品、该经营哪些关系。
businessTips.exampleEn: Palo Alto Networks agreed to buy Applied Compute for $4.5 billion, about $1.25 billion above the startup's valuation from just weeks earlier, because it fills a gap in AI security. On a smaller scale, a local cleaning business with strong contracts in one suburb may fetch a premium from a larger competitor expanding into that area.
businessTips.exampleZh: Palo Alto以45亿美元收购Applied Compute，比这家初创公司几周前的估值高出约12.5亿美元，因为它补上了AI安全的短板。小规模来看，一家在某个区拥有稳定合同的本地清洁公司，也可能被想扩张到该区的大竞争对手溢价收购。

businessTips.explanationEn: "Hawkish" describes central bankers who prioritise fighting inflation and favour higher interest rates; "dovish" describes those who prioritise growth and jobs and favour lower rates. Markets react not only to rate decisions but to the tone of speeches and meeting minutes, because they hint at future moves. A hawkish surprise usually lifts the currency and bond yields while pressuring stocks and gold.
businessTips.explanationZh: 「鹰派」指优先对抗通胀、倾向加息的央行官员；「鸽派」指优先关注增长和就业、倾向降息的官员。市场不仅对利率决议有反应，还会对讲话和会议纪要的语气作出反应，因为这些暗示着未来的走向。鹰派意外通常推高本币和债券收益率，同时压制股市和黄金。
businessTips.exampleEn: This week Fed Governor Waller floated a half-point hike, a clearly hawkish signal; the dollar hit a 19-month high and gold dropped nearly 3%. Investors who follow central-bank language can anticipate such moves instead of reacting after prices have already shifted.
businessTips.exampleZh: 本周美联储理事沃勒提出可能加息50个基点，这是明确的鹰派信号；美元随即创19个月新高，金价下跌近3%。关注央行措辞的投资者可以提前预判这类变化，而不是等价格变动后才被动应对。
